rules.title: Work in the owning package
rules.text: Make changes inside the package that owns the behavior and run commands scoped to that package.

rules.title: Filter commands by package
rules.text: Use the workspace filter (pnpm --filter, nx, turbo, cargo -p) to build and test only affected packages.

rules.title: Do not import across packages by path
rules.text: Depend on other packages through their published entry points, never through relative paths into their sources.

rules.title: Single version per dependency
rules.text: Keep one version of each shared dependency across the workspace and update it everywhere at once.

rules.title: Split independently deployed parts
rules.text: Split changes to independently deployed services or layers into separate pull requests and land producers before consumers.

rules.title: Record changes for release
rules.text: Add a changeset or changelog entry for every user-visible change to a published package.

rules.title: Root scripts for cross-cutting tasks
rules.text: Run lint, typecheck and test from the repository root for cross-package changes.

rules.title: Respect CODEOWNERS
rules.text: Check CODEOWNERS before editing files owned by other teams and keep such changes minimal.
